The overview is the level-1 crop with greatest display overlap, or level 0 if unavailable.

geometries.method: Representative midpoint of variable 5–10°S countercurrent trough on the western 55°E XBT shipping line; not a path endpoint.
geometries.positional_uncertainty: not quantified; no observed current core or path

length_assessments.illustration_limit: Drawn map-arrow span, not a physical current length or lower bound
length_assessments.scope: Repeated XBT shipping-line sections identify this flow, including a western line near 55°E with a variable trough around 5–10°S. Section transports and latitude bands are not an along-current length.
